Application Data.NAME: Sweet Serenity Bakery
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sweet Serenity Bakery operates as a retail bakery specializing in a diverse selection of baked goods, including fresh breads, pastries, and bagels. We offer limited on-premises seating and takeout service, ensuring a cozy environment for customers to enjoy our products. Our operations emphasize quality and safety, with all staff trained in food safety protocols, including ServSafe certification. Additionally, we implement stringent sanitation and refrigeration controls to maintain the highest quality standards. We also provide online ordering through a secure platform with robust cybersecurity measures to protect customer data and payment information.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a small fire broke out in the kitchen due to equipment malfunction, causing damage estimated at $3,500. The fire was quickly extinguished with minimal impact on operations, and no injuries were reported. The claim has been settled, and all safety protocols have since been reviewed and reinforced to prevent future incidents. Additionally, there was a minor theft incident on 07/10/2023, where cash totaling $1,500 was reported missing; this claim remains open as the investigation is ongoing.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: UL Listed Class II Safe, Grade B, Fire Resistant
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fence installed around the perimeter, 24/7 monitored alarm system, and regular security patrols.
